messages:
Aditi P: ReleaseBot blocked publish for redwood/worker:release-2026-03-21-rc1 — reason: tag annotation `ci.buildid` missing from manifest, provenance guard failing :warning:
ReleaseBot: publish blocked — missing required annotation: ci.buildid (policy: require-build-meta)
Jonas V: CI shows build finished and attestation created, but our publish step strips some annotations when constructing manifest list for multi-arch.
Tessa R: That sounds like the manifestlist generator script `/tools/manifestify` is dropping labels. We should not strip `ci.*` annotations.
Aditi P: Immediate mitigation: pin the tag to the exact digest produced by the trusted builder and add `release:manual-pin,ci.buildid=20260321-442` in DeployBot comment. Don't rebuild yet.
Infra Bot: advisory — manual pin allowed per emergency publish flow. Operator must include `ci.buildid` and CI url in DeployBot comment.
Jonas V: I'll run the manual put-image copy to recreate the tag with annotations. Command I'll run:
```
aws ecr batch-get-image --repository redwood/worker --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:aa11bb... 
# edit manifest to inject annotations, then put-image
aws ecr put-image --repository redwood/worker --image-manifest file://manifest-annotated.json --image-tag release-2026-03-21-rc1-pinned
```
Tessa R: After pin succeeds, have ReleaseBot re-verify. Then we can promote to canary. Also open a PR to change `/tools/manifestify` to preserve `ci.*` and `repo.metadata` annotations.
Aditi P: Adding a one-liner to release notes: "Promotion held; manual pin applied to preserve build provenance metadata."
ReleaseBot: verification passed for release-2026-03-21-rc1-pinned (ci.buildid=20260321-442) :white_check_mark:
Jonas V: done. Created a tiny incident with action items: fix manifestify + add CI pre-push assert for required annotations. Closing thread once PR lands.
